test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Kamala Lakshmi Narayanan is recognised all over the world as the foremost proponent of____ a southern Indian classical dance form that combines artistic expression with rhythmic footwork.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is a major form of Indian classical dance that originated in Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork combined with expressive hand gestures and facial expressions.
 
• The dance form is traditionally performed by women and has its roots in the temples of Tamil Nadu.
 
• Bharatanatyam is renowned for its grace, purity, tenderness, and sculpturesque poses.
 
• It is one of the oldest classical dance traditions in India, documented as far back as 2,000 years ago.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **History and Origin**

 
 
• Bharatanatyam is believed to have been inspired by the sculptures of the ancient temple of Chidambaram.
 
• The dance form was revived in the 20th century by prominent artists such as Rukmini Devi Arundale.
 
 
 
• **Training and Performance**
 
 
• Training in Bharatanatyam involves rigorous practice and learning of complex rhythms and expressions.
 
• Performers wear traditional costumes, usually a sari, and adorn themselves with jewelry and makeup.
 
 
 
• **Musical Accompaniment**
 
 
• The dance is typically accompanied by Carnatic music, and a live orchestra including instruments like the mridangam, violin, and veena.
 
• Vocal support is also an essential part of Bharatanatyam performances.
 
 
 
• **Major Exponents**
 
 
• Some of the notable exponents of Bharatanatyam include Rukmini Devi Arundale, Padma Subrahmanyam, and Yamini Krishnamurthy.
 
• These artists have significantly contributed to the global recognition and preservation of this classical dance form.
